name: Overwing gate
description: Checks every outbound message, reply and send-tool call before it goes: personal data, confidential leaks, toxicity, self-harm, severity. One recommended action per message: allow, redact, review or block. Shadow mode by default. Pays per check with an API key, an x402 wallet (ClawRouter's works) or the free allowance.

mode.description: shadow: evaluate and log what would have happened. enforce: act on the verdict. Default shadow.

apiKey.description: Overwing API key (ow_live_...). Optional: a free key lifts the 10-a-day allowance to 250 and keeps your checks on your dashboard. Takes precedence over the wallet.

walletKey.description: EVM private key (0x...) to pay $0.002 per check in USDC on Base over x402. Optional. If ClawRouter has a wallet at ~/.openclaw/blockrun/wallet.key it is used automatically.

onReview.description: What a review verdict does in enforce mode. allow: send and log. hold: cancel the send; for tool calls, ask the operator through OpenClaw's approval prompt. Default hold.

fallbackText.description: Text sent in place of a message that was redacted or blocked. Default: a short note that the message was held back.

ruleSet.description: Rule set slug. Default outbound-message. Custom sets need an API key.

tools.description: Tool names treated as outbound sends and checked in before_tool_call. Default ["message"].

maxPerCallUsd.description: Wallet rail: refuse to pay more than this for one check. Default 0.01.

dailyCapUsd.description: Wallet rail: stop paying after this much in a UTC day; checks fall back to the free allowance, then to shadow. Default 0.50.

timeoutMs.description: Give up on a check after this long and let the message through. Default 2500.

baseUrl.description: Override the API origin. Default https://overwing.ai.
